svg.title: Scribe: System Architecture
svg.desc: Layered diagram: Desktop (Tauri) and Browser clients on top, a unified Rust API in the middle hosting REST routes / Yjs realtime / compile pipeline / AI proxy, the data tier (Supabase Postgres, Object Storage, Redis, External AI providers) below, and a Desktop-local zone showing the SQLite mirror, bundled tectonic engine, materialised workdirs, and sync engine that let the desktop build work fully offline.
svg.text: Self-hostable collaborative LaTeX editor · React SPA · Rust API (Axum) · Tauri 2 desktop shell · Yjs CRDT · AGPL-3.0

g.text: Same React tree runs in-browser and inside
Hexagonal services · JWT auth · zod DTOs · tower middleware
Pull server files → SQLite on mount

svg.text: AGPL-3.0 · github.com/sunnyallana/scribe · built with Tauri, Rust, React, Yjs, Supabase
